text:
sam: quick q — i opened a tiny terraform change to add a configurable `configmap_rollout_grace_period` so canaries don't flip immediately when checksum bumps. link: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/+/PR-892

maya: nice. can you paste the tf var and the k8s annotation you plan to add? want to eyeball the default value (how long is 'grace'?)

sam: sure — thinking default = 30s, adjustable per-service. snippet from vars.tf:
```hcl
variable \"configmap_rollout_grace_period\" {
  type    = number
  default = 30 # seconds
  description = "Time to wait after configmap checksum change before marking rollout healthy"
}
```
and in the k8s deployment helm values we add an annotation so the controller knows to honor it:
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    infra.redwood.com/rollout-grace: \"${configmap_rollout_grace_period}s\"
```

chris: small note: 30s may be tight for services that need to warm caches or open DB connections. i'd prefer 120s for model-serving pods. can we make per-deployment override?

sam: yep per-deployment override is supported — terraform will push a value into helm values for the release. default is global but service teams can set values.

raj: main risk i see is race with secrets-sync. if secret rotator updates a secret around the same time as a cfgmap, controller might restart twice and the canary window becomes messy. do we have a plan to coalesce restarts?

maya: good call. i think the controller can check an annotation like `infra.redwood.com/coalesce-key: <timestamp>` and delay restarts until all changes settle. but that requires the rotator to set the annotation when it writes.

sam: thinking about adding a checksum key that is the hash of (configmap + linked-secrets). then controller only acts when that combined checksum changes. crude pseudo: `combined = sha256(configmap, secret1, secret2)`

chris: love the combined-hash idea. less noise. can we include a TTL so if secrets rotate frequently we still get cool-down?

sam: plan: `rollout-grace` + `coalesce-ttl` var. sample helm values fragment:
```yaml
infra:
  rolloutGrace: 120 # seconds
  coalesceTTL: 60 # seconds, group mutations within this window
```

deploy-bot: [automated] terraform plan finished for PR-892 — no changes to prod infra; only defaults added to variables.

sylvia: can someone add a short blurb to the runbook about expected behavior? i just ran into a canary that immediately flipped back because of interleaved cm + secret updates. would save folks a pager.

sam: will do. i'll add a section under "Configmap rollouts" with the flow and examples.

maya: for the PR reviewers: @chris @raj can you take a look at the terraform vars+readme? @sylvia would you proof the runbook text once i draft it?

chris: ack, will review later today. i want to test by simulating secret + cfgmap update in staging and watch the controller behavior.

raj: i'll add a tiny integra test in staging that rotates a fake secret and bumps a cfgmap within 30s to validate coalescing.

sylvia: happy to proof after draft. +1 for combined checksum approach.

sam: thanks everyone. i renamed the PR to "add rollout grace + coalesce ttl for configmap/secret updates" and added test plan. merging target is next Friday afternoon (low traffic).

deploy-bot: [automated] PR-892 merged into main by sam at 1749999001

sam: follow-up: after merge i'll send a short msg to service-owners with the default values and a sample helm override. :email:
